declared_refusals.reason: a binomial location-scale fit is refused at every seed when a noise-formula linear term lies in the location Duchon's null space (study-model-bin, 1-core repro); the calpred competitor is reported as refused until gam#3015 is fixed

the survival location-scale calpred fit ends outer smoothing uncertified: its ARC stalls at an indefinite Hessian while one smoothing parameter runs to its tail (study-model-surv, synthetic repro); reported as refused until gam#3037 is fixed

reasons.shipped.calibrate_sha: replicates gnomon calibrate as shipped at gnomon 1692eab7 (one joint Duchon over the PCs on gam's default kernel; Gaussian terms from gam's own term builder, #2393; no Weibull baseline target); not a tuning choice (update at the #2370 cutover pin)
reasons.fit_gate.min_events: SPEC section 8 (23:45Z): a model with fewer training events than about its coefficients is not estimable by any solver; 100, the bar shared competing fits already use
reasons.data.maximum_bytes_billed: SPEC section 7a 01:00Z: the six-domain EHR end is estimated at about 70 GB (66-95), see SCHEMA.md Byte estimate; plan() dry-run gates
reasons.compute.threads: sp-threads NOTES 01:25Z, measured: survival MS (p6_n50k) 537 s at T4, 297 s at T8, 194 s at T16; T8 keeps today's HTN K=6 fit (612-645 s, gam#3005) under the 900 s cap. Survival LS (pls6_n50k) 54 s at T1, 36 s at T4, 40 s at T16 with about 150 of 263 CPU-s spin at T16, so LS fits (death, exclusion, competitors) run single-threaded, many at once (54 CPU-s against 144 at T4). Single-search BMS keeps 85-90% efficiency at T4. Everything else is single-threaded.
reasons.compute.memory_headroom_fraction: the pool budgets every worker's measured resident set and the driver's; the rest of the task's memory is kept for the kernel, the page cache the frames are read through, and growth between the pool's 50 ms reads (lead 09-19: concurrency respects memory as well as cores)
reasons.cohort.num_pcs: user 23:40Z: 6 PCs if much faster; K=16 is a benchmark only
reasons.models.binary.num_pcs: user decision 2026-09-18 23:40Z: K = 6, as every model
reasons.models.binary.q_centers: a joint 6-D Duchon with a linear null space needs more than 7 centers, and gam's default grows with n (gam#2993); 24 is the lead's interim until study-pcs sweeps it
reasons.models.binary.slope_centers: as q_centers: more than 7 needed; 20 for the slope surface, interim until study-pcs
reasons.models.binary.windows: SPEC section 4 / audit N3: both window covariates in q for every method, as gam's default smooths
reasons.models.binary.latent_law: SPEC section 4: an empirical latent law, never standard-normal or auto
reasons.models.binary.slope_age_k: SPEC section 4 lets ours add age to the slope where the simulator shows it helps: on study-sim v1 medium dev seeds s(age, k=4) raised slope recovery from 0.30-0.60 to 0.67-0.88 and lowered risk RMSE for hypertension, T2D and AF; k=6 was no better
reasons.models.survival.num_pcs: user decision 2026-09-18 23:40Z: K = 6 (K = 16 cycles in gam's constrained QP; filed as a gam bug)
reasons.models.survival.q_centers: a joint 6-D Duchon with a linear null space needs more than 7 centers, and gam's default grows with n; 24 is interim until study-pcs sweeps it
reasons.models.survival.slope_centers: as q_centers: more than 7 needed; 20 for the slope surface, interim until study-pcs
reasons.models.survival.windows: SPEC section 4 / audit N3: both window covariates in q for every method, entered linearly
reasons.models.survival.latent_law: SPEC section 4: an empirical latent law, never standard-normal or auto
reasons.models.survival.death_model: SPEC section 8 M14: one location-scale death fit shared by every method

claims.rule: paired difference ours minus each competitor, computed against the simulator's TRUE probabilities, over fresh-seed replicates at production n; not worse when the upper 95% bound is at most the margin, worse (a bug) when the lower bound exceeds it, else inconclusive (SPEC section 8, 23:18Z)

convergence.reason: SPEC section 8 R1: non-convergence is numerical error, not sampling noise; a cell whose fit fails the 2-start test is never classified and is filed as a gam bug

rmse_true.reason: risk RMSE within max(2% of the competitor's, 0.0005): below a seed-to-seed change

oe_true.reason: calibration-in-the-large within 2 points of O/E = 1 against the true risk

cal_slope_true.reason: calibration slope within 0.05 of 1 against the true risk

auc_true.reason: expected AUC loss of at most 0.002, under a DeLong SE at biobank n

slope_recovery.reason: the PGS slope recovered within max(5%, 0.01) of the competitor's error
